scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Recognition Of Prior Learning
other_conditions: Must be between 18 and 45 years of age (unless higher age is approved by the PMKVY Executive Committee/State level Empowered Committee).
Must have prior experience in the specific job role as defined by the respective Sector Skill Council (SSC).
Must possess an Aadhaar and an Aadhaar‑linked bank account.
Must fulfill any additional work‑experience criteria specified by the SSCs for the respective job role.
benefits_summary: Certified candidates receive a cash reward of Rs. 500, a 3‑year accidental insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh, and an RPL kit including apparel and study material.
